settings.ggGkzOF8L4W_text: Using mouth tape during training forces nasal breathing, which improves oxygen efficiency and strengthens the respiratory muscles. Nasal breathing helps filter and humidify the air, reducing airway irritation and promoting better oxygen exchange. This leads to enhanced endurance, improved lung capacity, and more controlled breathing during intense workouts. Over time, training with mouth tape can help athletes optimize performance and recover more efficiently.
